analysis.title: Research Unplugged: Equities and Credit for 2027
key_insights: Podcast with GS Equity Strategy (Ben Snider, Ryan Hammond) and Credit Strategy (Amanda Lynam, Arun Manohar) covering the 2027 outlook for equities and credit, including the S&P 500 target, how AI fits in, the path for corporate earnings, and favorite ideas.

The extractable text is the cover page, topic list, resource links and disclosure appendix only. The podcast discussion and slide content are not in the document, so no S&P 500 target, earnings forecast, spread forecast or specific stock idea can be extracted.

Topic segments by approximate start time: Set-Up for Stocks & Bonds into 2027 (0:27), Pulse Check: The AI Trade from Credit to Equities (5:54), 2027 Equities Outlook (10:54), Equity Market Themes for 2027 (13:39), 2027 Credit Outlook (18:02), 2027 Mortgage & Structured Products Outlook (22:30), Favorite Ideas (25:58).

Related GS research cited: 'Nov-18: 2027 Global Credit Outlook: Fading Tailwinds and a Growing AI Divide', 'Nov-18: 2027 Mortgage & Structured Products Outlook: Carry Beckons, Fundamentals Anchor', 'Nov-17: 2027 US Equity Outlook: The beginning of the middle', 'Nov-12: Global Markets Outlook 2027: Growing Pains', 'Nov-12: Global Equity Strategy 2027 Outlook: Finding Value in Growth'. The titles hint at fading credit tailwinds and a split between AI-exposed and other issuers, but this document does not state the arguments.
